name: Excalidraw
description: Excalidraw lets agents draw hand-drawn style diagrams in the chat and export them to excalidraw.com as a shareable link. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: Draw a diagram of a web app with a load balancer, two API servers, and a database.
Sketch the sign-up flow from landing page to first login.
Export this diagram to Excalidraw and give me the link.

apps.name: Excalidraw
apps.description: Diagram drawing and export, over the Excalidraw MCP server with no sign-in.
